Javed vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. on 22 March,
2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Court No. - 16
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 3229 of 2023
Applicant :- Javed

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Dhananjay Trivedi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
Heard Sri Dhananjay Trivedi, the learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Manoj Kumar Sahu, the learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The instant application has been filed seeking bail for the applicant in Case Crime no. 357 of 2022,
under Section 366, 376 D, 506 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Reusa, District Sitapur.

The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 21.09.2022 against one Nafis Rain, alleging that the aforesaid named accused person had enticed away the informant's daughter aged about 19 years on 12/13.09.2022 and that the informant's daughter had taken away Rs. 1500/-,
a pair of anklets, her Aadhaar Card and three sets of clothes.
In the statement of the alleged victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she stated that the named accused Nafis Rain had taken her away stating that he would marry her.
After about one week, Nafis Rain told that he was already married and he would get the victim married with some other person.
He further stated that some other persons Aslam, Afsar, Javed (applicant) and Aleem were also pressurizing her to marry the applicant but she declined.

sentences.text: The alleged victim was taken for medico legal examination but before the doctor she stated that she was only teased and no misdeed was committed with her and, therefore, she did not want to get herself medically examined.
In the radio logical examination the aged of the victim has been opined to be 17 years.

Subsequently, in the statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., she stated that she had been taken away by named accused Nafis Rain and the applicant, and she levelled the allegation of committing rape against the named accused Nafis Rain as also against the applicant.
The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the named accused Nafis Rain has already been granted bail by means of an order dated 14.02.2023 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 791 of 2023.
Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant was not named in the F.I.R.; there was no allegation of rape levelled against him even in the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., that the victim declined to undergo medico legal examination and she categorically stated before the doctor that no misdeed had been committed with her and that it is only in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., that the allegation of rape has been levelled for the same time and also keeping in view the fact that the named accused Nafis Rain has already been granted bail, I am of the view that the applicant is also entitled to be enlarged on bail in the aforesaid case.
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
Let the applicant Javed be released on bail in Case Crime no. 357 of 2022, under Section 366, 376 D,
506 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Reusa, District Sitapur on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of magistrate/court concerned, subject to following conditions: -
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
.
